video_title: He's Chasing Greatness! Shaq Breaks Down LeBron's Next Chapter in Philly

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith criticizes the Slam Dunk Contest's recent decline
quotes.excerpt: I think that what has happened to the Slam Dunk Contest for All-Star weekend has been a travesty.
quotes.quote: I think that what has happened to the Slam Dunk Contest for All-Star weekend has been a travesty. I think that it has been awful. Even though I give major props to Mac McClung, the fact that a G-Leaguer came into the NBA All-Star weekend and took it over and won three times, as much credit as he deserves, it's also shameful that others didn't participate. I remember one year giving major props to Jaylen Brown because he participated in the Slam Dunk Contest, and I really, really appreciated that because he's a star in this league and he didn't have to do that, but he did it.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith proposes a nationwide Slam Dunk Contest
quotes.excerpt: Have a nationwide Slam Dunk Contest. I've proposed this on this radio show, I've proposed it on television.
quotes.quote: Have a nationwide Slam Dunk Contest. I've proposed this on this radio show, I've proposed it on television. I've proposed it to the commissioner of the National Basketball Association, Adam Silver. I did so years ago, unofficially. I think there should be a nationwide Slam Dunk Contest. Based on that nationwide Slam Dunk Contest, the top 10 dunkers are picked, and the top 5 All-Stars from each conference sponsors a particular player. You're just coaching them. You're participating by coaching them and being involved in them. That way they're involved but they don't have to dunk. Let these brothers put on a show for the fans, while a star, a Steph Curry, a LeBron James, and others, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and others, Luka and others, pick the player they want to sponsor and sponsor one of those 10 players for the Dunk Contest.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith blames LeBron James for ruining the Dunk Contest
quotes.excerpt: I've also been on the record stating that's the biggest critique I've had against LeBron James.
quotes.quote: I've also been on the record stating that's the biggest critique I've had against LeBron James. I think he ruined the Slam Dunk Contest. I think it's all his fault. I've said that many times, because he's the first superstar with the athleticism that had him playing above the rim that refused to participate in the Slam Dunk Contest, and everybody followed.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal explains the origin of his Dunkman League
quotes.excerpt: Dunking has always been the most magnificent shot in the game.
quotes.quote: Dunking has always been the most magnificent shot in the game. We all waited for the All-Star game for the top players to compete in the dunk contest. My favorite dunk contest by far was Michael Jordan versus Dominique. Then Vince Carter had a great one, Kobe won one, I remember I was there for that one. Then it kind of went away for a while and then I was a judge on the Zach LaVine, Aaron Gordon, and I started to see a lot of kids on the internet doing stuff that NBA players can't do. I remember that one kid, Jordan Kilganon, at the All-Star game came in jeans doing a timeout and just went up and dunked behind the back and all the NBA players were going, 'What is that?' That's what I'm looking for in Dunkman.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith questions LeBron James' move to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James decided to take his talents to Philadelphia. What were your thoughts about that move?
quotes.quote: LeBron James decided to take his talents to Philadelphia. What were your thoughts about that move?

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal defends LeBron James' decision to join the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: He's chasing the chairs to continue to be great, to continue to add legacy to his book.
quotes.quote: I don't think it's for him. It's funny to me that people that don't have rings are saying, 'Oh, he's a ring chaser.' No, he's continuance chasing. He's chasing the chairs to continue to be great, to continue to add legacy to his book. Listen, he doesn't really know he has, but you and I know when this thing is over, it's over. You can't come back. Once you retire, once your body says I can't go no more, it's over. This guy feels he has two, three years left. Why not try to get another championship? I did it. After I won three in a row and then won one in Miami, hey, towards the end of my career, let me go play with Paul and KG and you know, be like the fourth guy and rebound and set picks and you know, see if I can win one. And you know, that's what he's doing.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal worries about Tyrese Maxey's role in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: The person I feel sorry for is Tyrese Maxey.
quotes.quote: The person I feel sorry for is Tyrese Maxey. He came in a regular guy, Joel Embiid was hurt most of the year, Tyrese rose up like, 'Hey, I'm the star, this is my team.' Now you bring Jaylen Brown in, is he going to take a step back? And not only that, you bring LeBron in, is he going to take another step back? Now Joel comes in shape and he wants to play, he's going to have to revert back to just being a regular guy, and will that affect him? Because he was starting to make a name for himself. I think he made the All-Star team, he was a star, and sometimes one or two people on the team is going to have to defer. Defer to who? I don't know, whether defer to Jaylen, defer to LeBron, defer to Embiid, I don't know.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith argues Tyrese Maxey wanted LeBron and Jaylen
quotes.excerpt: What about the notion that Tyrese Maxey wanted this because he got tired of losing?
quotes.quote: What about the notion that Tyrese Maxey wanted this because he got tired of losing and they can't get out of the second round? And he wanted Jaylen Brown, he wanted LeBron James. Hell, he was on a phone call with LeBron James trying to convince LeBron James to come. I think that goes a long way because it's not something that's thrusted upon you by management, it's something you asked for, and I think that's something that's going to work for Tyrese Maxey because he's that kind of dude.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal questions Jaylen Brown's fit in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown has clearly said he wants to be the man. Will he be the man?
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown has clearly said he wants to be the man. Will he be the man? Will he defer? Again, on paper this thing looks fabulous, but chemistry-wise, only time will tell. You know, like if you look at all the top teams, for example, OKC. All the OKC, even though they got a lot of weapons on that team, they know that Shai is the man. Here Shai, you take your shots. The good thing about Shai is he let everybody else eat. He lets Jay Dub eat, he lets you know everybody eat on the team. Same thing with the Knicks. Brunson, you are the man, and then Brunson when he gets double, he give it up, everybody eats. Will Philadelphia and Nick Nurse create that type of system to where if either Jaylen Brown is the man, he has the ball, LeBron has the ball, and you know, we'll let your other guys eat when your opportunity comes? We shall see.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal demands a championship from LeBron and Jaylen
quotes.excerpt: It's championship or bust for LeBron and Jaylen.
quotes.quote: It's championship or bust for LeBron and Jaylen. I don't want to hear about, 'Oh, 60 games, we made the playoffs.' No, it's championship or bust.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith reminds Shaq about the Heat's second-year championship
quotes.excerpt: You got to Miami, y'all had to wait a year. You didn't win it the first year.
quotes.quote: It can't be year two. Excuse me, you got to Miami, y'all had to wait a year. You didn't win it the first year in Miami, you had to wait the second year. How come they can't wait the second year?

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal blames his 2006 Heat loss on injury
quotes.excerpt: That's because I had a thigh bruise and I was taking shots and we lost that game seven.
quotes.quote: That's because I had a thigh bruise and I was taking shots and we lost that game seven. I was not 100% healthy. If I was 100% healthy, I would have gave you two in a row, because you know I was on the mission. I got in shape, I lost 60 pounds, I was 325, I was on the mission. I had Dwyane Wade and the boys rolling. We would have won that first year. I'm telling you, if we'd have beat Detroit, we would end up playing San Antonio, we would have beat them, it would have been my second ring. That's my excuse. It didn't happen. You're right. But guess what, it was championship or bust for me too. I didn't get a championship. You think I was out partying that summer? No, I was not. So championship or bust, not excuses.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal discusses Joel Embiid's need to step up
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid, time for him to step up.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid, time for him to step up. Just saying. He better take some Tylenol and take some shots. He's missed more games than me. Yes, that's what I'm trying to tell you. He's missed 150, 350 games over the last three years. He's never hurt, he's never healthy. I tell you what, I'm I'm I'm I'm calling it out now. He's going to be healthy this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith says a healthy Embiid guarantees a championship
quotes.excerpt: If he's healthy, they win the chip.
quotes.quote: If he's healthy, they win the chip. If he's healthy, they win the chip.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal predicts Joel Embiid will dominate
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is going to dominate this year.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid is going to dominate this year. You heard it here first. Joel Embiid will be titled as the best big man in the league. He's passing up the Joker this year. He's going to work this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith questions Stephen Curry's future
quotes.excerpt: What does Stephen Curry do now?
quotes.quote: What does Stephen Curry do now? We know he's the greatest shooter God ever created. He's still playing like a superstar at age 38, but he only played 43 games last year. You know he's due to he's eligible for an extension all of this other stuff. But Jimmy Butler ain't going to be there for most of the season, Moses Moody is hurt, it's just him and Draymond, bro, and Podziemski. I mean, they don't have much, man. What does Stephen Curry do, Shaq?

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal praises Stephen Curry's legacy
quotes.excerpt: Stephen Curry's legacy is already complete.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry's legacy is already complete. It's complete. You know why it's complete? Because while everybody was talking about LeBron being number one or number two, this little light-skinned kid dominated in LeBron's era, and he beat LeBron. And if I'm mistaken, doesn't he have one more ring more than LeBron?

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith clarifies Curry and LeBron's ring count
quotes.excerpt: No, they both have four.
quotes.quote: No, they both have four.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal calls Curry a great player
quotes.excerpt: Okay, okay, they both have four, so, hey, look at this little kid.
quotes.quote: Okay, okay, they both have four, so, hey, look at this little kid. Pabbish patch doll, little cute little kid that you could take home and babysit him. Dude has four rings, he's a great player. It's unfortunate that, uh, Bob Myers left and you know, they're not really operating like they used to operate.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal believes Curry belongs in the GOAT conversation
quotes.excerpt: I've always said, how come you don't put him in the goat category?
quotes.quote: I've always said, how come you don't put him in the goat category? I'm absolutely serious.
